name: Judith Allen
notable_stories: The preparer calls Judy his pal and 'second Mom'; when his parents were having difficulties he would drive to her place in Moorpark, and she always knew what to say.
milestones: Born 6 Jul 1938, Portland, Multnomah County, OR
career: Taught English at Moorpark College in southern California
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
